notes: H2 Piepho estimator (Piepho & Mohring 2007 eq.19): two PROC MIXED runs produce variance components (genotype-random) and pairwise differences (genotype-fixed), then H2 = sigma_g^2 / (sigma_g^2 + 0.5 * avd_BLUE). Macro %H2_piepho inlined directly (original uses proc http to load from GitHub). Data is inline DATALINES from the original example script.
